youtube.title: Free study in Germany? The full truth
youtube.description:
Most public universities in Germany charge no tuition fee, but the semester contribution, living costs and proof of funds for the visa are all on you. Some states and universities also charge non-EU students fees.

Free doesn't mean zero cost.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. You contact us, we never contact you first.
